    Video shows crazy Aran Islands ferry moment as passengers get soaked

    The journey to the islands can be an adventure in itself

    Comments0
    News
    Sean Crosbie
    12:01, 11 Oct 2026
    Listen to audio version of this article
    Sponsored by
    0:00 / 2:04
    Instaread

    Passengers onboard a ferry headed to the Aran Islands got more than they bargained for when rough seas meant water came crashing into the seating area below deck.

    ‌

    In a video shared online by one of the passengers, three of the ferry's crew can be seen wrestling to get the door leading to the upper deck as water comes crashing in.

    ‌

    Despite a few of the passengers allegedly experiencing some seasickness from the rough conditions, it appears as though most of those on board saw the funny side in the carnage as there is plenty of laughter to be heard in the video.

    ‌
    • READ MORE: Gardai arrest six men following violent incident in Galway town
    • READ MORE: Met Eireann map pinpoints exact areas to be hit by heavy rain

    Gardai arrest six men following violent incident in Galway town

    Thankfully, the three crew members managed to get the door closed before all of the passengers got soaked.

    The video of the chaotic scene was shared by Instagram user issiegintert.

    ‌

    She captioned the video: "So this happened on the ferry boat ride out to the islands.

    "Not only did everyone get seasick (myself included) but some lucky passengers got an ocean bath.

    ‌

    "Definitely a trip to remember!"

    Galway Tourism also shared the video online, saying: "Sometimes the journey to the Aran Islands is an adventure in itself!"
